target_definition: Depth-weighted blend of Open-Meteo's modelled hourly soil_moisture_7_to_28cm and soil_moisture_28_to_100cm layers (weights 19/72 and 53/72), aggregated to a daily mean. A public reanalysis-derived weak label, not a sensor measurement.

train_test_split.description: Locations were assigned to train/test before any data was collected (backend/config/ai_bootstrap_locations.yaml `split` field). No day from a test location appears in training, so metrics measure generalization to an unseen location rather than interpolation between nearby days at the same location.

metrics.note: Performance against PUBLIC MODELLED SOIL-MOISTURE WEAK LABELS (Open-Meteo reanalysis-derived root-zone proxy), evaluated only on held-out test locations. This is NOT accuracy against real soil sensors — no in-situ Uzbekistan ground truth exists yet.

model_selection.description: A compact set of XGBoost hyperparameter candidates was scored with GroupKFold cross-validation (groups = training locations only), never touching the final held-out test locations. The candidate with the best mean CV R2 was refit on all training rows.

global_mean_baseline.note: Performance against PUBLIC MODELLED SOIL-MOISTURE WEAK LABELS (Open-Meteo reanalysis-derived root-zone proxy), evaluated only on held-out test locations. This is NOT accuracy against real soil sensors — no in-situ Uzbekistan ground truth exists yet.

ridge_regression.note: Performance against PUBLIC MODELLED SOIL-MOISTURE WEAK LABELS (Open-Meteo reanalysis-derived root-zone proxy), evaluated only on held-out test locations. This is NOT accuracy against real soil sensors — no in-situ Uzbekistan ground truth exists yet.

random_forest.note: Performance against PUBLIC MODELLED SOIL-MOISTURE WEAK LABELS (Open-Meteo reanalysis-derived root-zone proxy), evaluated only on held-out test locations. This is NOT accuracy against real soil sensors — no in-situ Uzbekistan ground truth exists yet.

weak_label_source: Open-Meteo Archive API (ERA5-Land reanalysis-derived hourly soil moisture), 2023-01-01 to 2025-12-31, 15 bootstrap Uzbekistan locations (backend/config/ai_bootstrap_locations.yaml).
limitations: This model estimates a MODELLED root-zone soil-moisture PROXY derived from public reanalysis data; it does not measure actual field soil moisture and has not been validated against any in-situ sensor.

Absolute volumetric soil moisture has a large location-specific baseline (see this script's diagnosis output); held-out-location generalization is materially weaker than the wetness-index formulation trained on the same data — see ai_soil_wetness_index_v0.1's metadata for comparison.
Training data covers a bootstrap set of ~15 representative Uzbekistan locations and 2023-2025; not validated across other years, crop types, or irrigation practices.
The weak-label target itself is a model output (Open-Meteo/ERA5-Land derived), not ground truth.
Not yet used to alter any irrigation recommendation or water-balance calculation — see CLAUDE.md.
